description: The Small Area Population Statistics (SAPS) of Ireland's 2022 census are the full set of census tables for 18,919 small areas and for electoral divisions, towns, local electoral areas, counties and the State, published by the Central Statistics Office. Fifteen themes cover people, families and households. The housing theme counts permanent private households by type of accommodation, period built (pre-1919 to 2016 or later), tenure, rooms and bedrooms, central heating fuel (oil, natural gas, electricity, coal, peat, LPG, wood), water supply (public main, group schemes, other private source), sewerage facility (public scheme, individual septic tank, other treatment), occupancy status of dwellings on census night, the number of renewable energy sources and smoke alarms. The commuting theme gives means of travel to work, school or college, time leaving home, journey time and working from home, and another theme counts cars and the type of internet connection. The CSO runs the census to support planning at local level. Format and access: one wide CSV per geography with a glossary of column codes, free to download; matching boundaries are on the Tailte Éireann open data portal, and the tables are also in the PxStat database with an API. Licence: CC BY 4.0, free. Caveats: the files are wide tables with hundreds of coded columns that need the glossary, and each table has a not stated category. Simulation uses: local building stock age and heating for retrofit and energy demand, water and wastewater service types, commuting mode shares for transport models, and exposure. Related records: the CSO networked gas and data centre electricity records.
